svg.aria-label: How to make a Ramos Gin Fizz, step by step: Combine ingredients. Add everything except the soda water to your shaker. Dry shake. Shake hard, without ice, for about 15 seconds. That's what starts the foam. Shake. And keep shaking. Add ice and shake as hard as you can, for a good minute or two. Strain. Strain into a chilled highball glass, no ice. Top with soda water. Pour it in slowly, and watch the foam rise. Cheers!
